description: Two-way arbitrage across Novig, FanDuel and DraftKings (both legs, the stake split for 100 units and the guaranteed margin), or middles where lines differ (type=middles). Production and Scale. Costs 3 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/arbitrage. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 50. Free returns at most 100.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.
